survey: A beach ball rests on rippled sand, seen slightly from above. Its body is a sphere made of curved gore panels: red, white, blue, white and green are visible, with white panels alternating with colored ones. All panels meet at a round purple cap near the top, which reads as the valve or end cap. Each panel is narrow at the cap, widens toward the middle and narrows again toward the bottom, as gores on a real sphere do. The outline is round. The ball sits slightly sunk into the sand and casts a contact shadow, so it is clearly supported.
